review_report.superseded: A newer reassessment supersedes this report. Select the latest run; this report is historical only.

review_report.comparison_boundary: Only exact assertions are matched. Unmatched findings are not verified as fixed or withdrawn.
review_report.same_source: The source revision is unchanged; differences cannot be attributed to a code or document fix.
review_report.not_reobserved: Not observed this round; closure unverified
review_report.handoff_boundary: Verify the original requirement and evidence before making the minimum fix. This handoff does not authorize scope expansion, acceptance, merge or publication.
review_report.document_next: Address blockers or verify pending evidence; document approval is not implementation acceptance.
review_report.wait_next: Wait for review completion; resolve execution errors before judging findings.
review_report.legacy_policy: The exact policy version was not recorded for this historical run.
review_report.code_completed: Review completed; human decision still required
review_report.code_next: Review findings and missing coverage, then make a version-bound human decision.
review_report.legacy_groups: This historical report has no change groups; see the original coverage details.
